artifacts.title: Brief K3 — Three Axes: Clarity, Connection, Convenience
artifacts.summary: CEO market-framing brief mapping Clarity/Connection/Convenience axes with inline-cited sources. Convenience = won by Doctolib (EU consumer) + ZorgDomein (NL B2B rail). Connection = fragmented/low-tech (CaringBridge, Caren/Carenzorgt, Kanker.nl, Belong.Life, WhatsApp default). Clarity deep-dive: OpenEvidence ($12bn, 40%+ US docs, NO consumer plan, WITHDREW from EU/UK May 2026 over AI Act); no scaled consumer citation-grounded oncology Q&A exists (Ada, Healthily, Wysa, Belong adjacent); symptom-tracking/viz field (Bearable 900k, Visible, Guava, Vinehealth acqui-hired by Sciensus, MyTherapy); AI summaries overlap Abridge/Nabla. Moat verdict: raw intelligence & citation-grounding are commoditized (OpenAI shipped ChatGPT-for-Clinicians Apr 2026); defensible compound = healthcare UX x clinician-grounded trust x EU-native compliance x patient-owned longitudinal data x care circle. Contrarian: 40m/day use ChatGPT for health, consumers under-value privacy. Reframe Clarity as 'understanding YOUR care,' not generic health Q&A.

artifacts.title: The Care Brain Master Synthesis — An Open Assistant for Health
artifacts.summary: Flat, 24-month master synthesis consolidating the Care Brain corpus into one canonical 'what we're building and why' document. Positions Ditto as the open assistant for health (specialized, not general-purpose), modeled on Claude Code/OpenCode tuned for healthcare. Eleven sections: (1) Context & Thesis; (2) Architectural Foundation — pipeline plugin framework, typed health graph, LLM wiki projection, two-mode retrieval (fact + filter) with similarity as explicit escape hatch, five architectural principles, pipeline contract; (3) The Assistant's Checklist — 45 JTBD across 8 themes; (4) The Magic Map — 22 wow moments; (5) Capability Milestone Map with 5 tiers (Foundation, Magic Activation, Compounding Intelligence, Network & Platform, Data Sovereignty); (6) Founder Panel from 10 voices; (7) Cross-Cutting Concerns; (8) Kill List; (9) Risks & Mitigations including Anthropic Claude for Healthcare; (10) Open Questions (10 strategic forks); (11) What's Handled Later; (12) Validated Sources Appendix. Supersedes roadmap sections of prior docs; respects canonical architecture from direction-c-nervous-system.md. Updated 2026-04-15 with internet-validated facts (OpenCode confirmed, EHDS timing sharpened to 2029 cross-border exchange, Anthropic Claude for Healthcare added) and architectural refinement (similarity demoted from first-class mode to escape hatch per user architectural insight).

artifacts.title: The Care Wiki — A Fork of Karpathy's LLM Wiki for Healthcare
artifacts.summary: Architectural spec for Ditto's adaptation (fork) of Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern into the Care Brain. Specifies the LLM-facing projection layer that sits on top of the Health Profile Store. Three-layer model: raw sources (immutable) / Health Graph (DB, source of truth — Yuri's correction to Karpathy) / Care Wiki projection (LLM-facing markdown, auto-maintained by pipelines). Nine material forks from Karpathy's original: source of truth is DB not markdown, pipelines write via typed contract not LLM free-form, multi-tenant per-patient isolation, per-viewer projections (patient/partner/daughter/GP), event-driven ingest, PR-style review for high-stakes pages, DB-backed virtual filesystem, multi-language with canonical+translation, similarity demoted with each use triggering schema extension. Includes concrete page templates (entity, concept, timeline, index, log), three new workers to add (wiki_render, wiki_reviewer, wiki_lint), three-tier review flow (LLM-as-reviewer / patient-in-the-loop / clinical), performance targets, GDPR/isolation/audit controls, migration sequence from current state, 10 open questions. Unlocks Journey Page (Moment #14), Condition Page (#19), and makes longitudinal memory + audience adaptation cheap for a 10-person team.

artifacts.title: The Interface: Design Panel Brainstorm (10 designers, 3 merge directions)
artifacts.summary: Design exploration for the Care Brain interface shape. Ten design personas (Ive, Gebbia, Spalter, Headspace, Rams, Saarinen/Linear, Jason Yuan/Dia, Bierut, Kouthoofd/Teenage Engineering, Kare) each propose a distinct approach to holding 45 JTBD + 22 wow moments without becoming a chatbot or a generic dashboard. Staged fictional cross-critique surfaces seven points of agreement (no single interface for all cohorts, the card is the atomic unit, the share is the hero surface, emotional weight token as infrastructure, anticipatory layer on top of navigable one, editorial framing undervalued, iconography earns place in accessibility and shares) and two unresolved tensions (object-vs-canvas, solemnity-vs-character). Three merge directions: α Living Paper (editorial × presence × craft — emotional dignity), β Home Feed (hospitality × story × warmth — relational virality), γ Atelier (system × operator × ambient intelligence — longitudinal capability). Recommendation: stratify — α as shell, β as share surface, γ as operator mode, Kare-style pictographic mode for cognitive-adaptation. Emotional weight token as cross-cutting primitive. Explicit non-goal: inventing a new paradigm. Interface is the vessel, architecture is the differentiator.

artifacts.title: Lenny's Panel — A Contrarian Critique of the Care Brain Synthesis
artifacts.summary: Contrarian critique of the master synthesis + wiki architecture from six Lenny's-podcast-guest archetypes: Shreyas Doshi (LNO / leverage), Marty Cagan (empowered teams, discovery), April Dunford (positioning, competitive alternative), Teresa Torres (continuous discovery), Brian Balfour (four fits, retention), Gibson Biddle (DHM, proxy metrics). Each takes hardest swing from their framework. Converges on six consensus critiques: comprehensiveness over focus, no real user evidence, warm positioning without operational rigor, retention hand-waving, care-graph moat assumed not proven, prescriptive plan where exploratory needed. Names five decisions the synthesis flinches on (caregiver-vs-patient customer, 45-JTBD compression to 3, B2C-vs-B2B2C commitment, retention truth, summary's kill-date). Joint prescription: collapse the 17K-word corpus to a one-pager with Dunford-compliant positioning, named beachhead, 3 JTBDs, 1 PMF proxy, 1 retention commitment, 1 moat thesis, 3 decisions for the quarter. Artifact serves as loyal-opposition to the strategy docs.

artifacts.title: Care Brain — One-Pager (Committed Strategy)
artifacts.summary: Canonical one-pager produced in response to the Lenny's panel critique (spec-016). Committed — not exploratory. Beachhead: patients on serious-condition tracks (oncology primary, neurodegenerative second) + their one to three direct loved ones, Netherlands first. Data anchor: 50% of current Ditto active users are on an oncology track, so wedge is real. Positioning: 'Ditto is the care-journey assistant for families facing cancer and neurodegenerative disease. One recording, everyone informed, nothing falls through the cracks.' Three committed JTBDs (other 42 go to extensions): Hold the story, Share without burden, Catch what fragmented care misses. Three anchor magical moments: Journey Page, Share That Writes Itself, Cross-Doctor Catch. Four architectural decisions: pipeline plugin framework, typed health graph + wiki projection, fact+filter retrieval with similarity demoted, PR-style review loop. Three commitments: PMF proxy (% oncology patients sending ≥1 adapted share/month by cohort), retention commitment (publish 90-day curve in 14 days, gate Tier 0 on it), moat thesis + 90-day proof point (median oncology patient has ≥2 circle members reading weekly 90 days post adapted-share V1). Three decisions this quarter with owners+dates (partner-first-vs-patient-first, neurodegenerative parallel-vs-later, summary kill-date). Links to all extensions (specs 012-016, business-case, competitive-analysis). The one-pager is the spine; everything else extends from it and must stay consistent with it.

artifacts.title: Care Brain — Magic Paths (Multi-Moment User Journeys)
artifacts.summary: Extends the one-pager by mapping coherent multi-moment user journeys (paths) that chain JTBDs and wow moments into lived experiences. Three initial paths: (1) Post-Appointment One-Click Cascade — one screen after every recording with pre-filled follow-up appointments, structured action items, matched pre-prepared questions with resolved/unresolved flags, adapted share previews per circle role; promoted to Tier 1 anchor surface. (2) Symptom Tracking via Voice — zero-friction daily voice check-ins, structured symptom extraction against finite ontology, time-series visualization, weekly pattern detection, automatic carry-forward into appointment prep. (3) Inbound Reaction Loop — guided reaction flow for circle members (heartfelt message + structured help offer + call-me CTA), curated patient inbox in a sacred Circle tab, agentic scheduling for accepted calls, bilateral confirmation of help commitments; architecturally net-new because it flips the graph direction (circle members generate events into patient's graph, not just receive). Path 3 is identified as the #1 mechanism for care-graph density and thus the primary growth lever tied to the moat thesis. Twelve new pipelines specified, nine new event types, six new wiki page types, three new UI surfaces (Cascade, Symptoms, Circle). Implies two refinements to one-pager: JTBD #2 reframed as bidirectional; Path 1 cascade promoted to Tier 1 anchor. Template extendable for future paths (Crisis Handoff, End-of-Treatment, New Specialist Onboarding, Caregiver Self-Care, Ambient Prep).

artifacts.title: Care Brain Prototype — Implementation Specs for Managed Agents
artifacts.summary: Six-file implementation spec suite for managed agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Devin) to build a working Care Brain prototype. PROTOTYPE_README (manifest, goals, success criteria, non-goals). 01-core-architecture (plugin framework, event bus, health graph, wiki projection, two-mode retrieval, review loop, eval harness, LLM client abstraction — five non-negotiable principles, eight components, minimum viable checklist). 02-path-1-post-appointment-cascade (anchor Tier 1 path: recording → four-card cascade screen with appointments, actions, pre-question matches, adapted shares — four new pipelines, cascade JSON API endpoint, three eval scenarios). 03-path-2-symptom-tracking (voice check-ins → structured symptoms → time-series visualization → weekly pattern detection → feeds into appointment prep — three new pipelines, chart spec format, 15-type symptom ontology, nine eval scenarios). 04-path-3-reaction-loop (inbound reactions from circle members with heartfelt messages + structured help offers + call scheduling — flips the graph direction for network density — five new pipelines, inbox API, sacred-channel rule, privacy rules, ten eval scenarios). 05-data-schemas (canonical reference: event envelope + 24 event types, 13 health graph entity schemas, symptom ontology, pipeline contract schema, wiki page frontmatter, WikiEdit diff, audit log, API response shapes, fixture data specs, schema versioning). Thorough on WHAT (contracts, schemas, endpoints, eval criteria, constraints), hands-off on HOW (agent chooses language, framework, ORM, prompt templating). Technology suggested: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/JSONB, Anthropic Claude, pytest.

artifacts.title: Funnel Leverage Model — Python Cohort Stock-and-Flow Simulator (v3) + Porygon Data Requests + Research Memo
artifacts.summary: Calibrated mathematical model of Ditto's user funnel. v3 is a Python discrete-time Markov cohort simulator (model/) with state vector [s_0..s_11, s_loyal], three-tier retention (r₁=0.54 cliff, r₂=0.66 stable core, r_loyal=0.91 loyal self-loop hypothesis), Care Circle viral loop K≈0.012, passive as multiplier (0.36×activated), committed floor slider. Produces 24-month MAU trajectory + analytical asymptote; 8 pytest sanity tests (baseline flat, simulated→closed-form asymptote match, inflow-drop is gradual not cliff, retention lift compounds, loyal self-loop conserved, sensitivity ordering, K<1 guard). Fixes v2's 'scenario number is the asymptote' artifact: dropping Inflow 5k→1k now shows ~30% M1 drop (was 80% cliff), approaching new asymptote of 355 by M12. Synthetic calibration today; calibration.py auto-detects filled Porygon CSV templates. porygon-data-requests.md documents 10 requests across 3 tiers with 9 concrete CSV templates: 1.1 stock by tenure (Tier 1 blocking), 1.2 cohort retention matrix, 1.3 loyal tail retention, 2.1 growth accounting (New/Resurrected/Retained/Churned), 2.2 passive retention, 2.3 installs weekly, 2.4 Life Moment retention, 3.1 invite latency, 3.2 invite rate by tenure, 3.3 passive source split. Six initiative presets (Care Circle v2, Onboarding→Aha, Retain the Activated, Menzis partnership, Quality-of-inflow shift, Journey Page) port from v2. v1+v2 HTML retained for A-B reference. growth-frameworks-research.md (revised 2026-04-22) positions v3 as L3 Markov cohort (pulled forward from original v4 slot), re-sequences v4 to focus on data upgrades (per-tenure retention fit from 1.2, passive as own cohort from 2.2, Life Moment from 2.4, growth accounting from 2.1), v5 experiment linkage + MMM, v6 causal. Key honest insights: (1) activated base is inflow-heavy short run — s_0 is ~38% of activated MAU; (2) retention has biggest compounding leverage (r₂ 12m elasticity +1.47 vs funnel-conversion +0.98 vs viral params +0.01); (3) Care Circle loop is tiny at current K≈0.012 — invite→install leakage (untracked) is where the real leverage hides; (4) loyal tail is small (~2%) but cushions transients.

artifacts.title: Market & Trend Analysis — Outside-In Strategy Scan
artifacts.summary: Outside-in competitor/market/trend research feeding Merlijn's strategy synthesis (product + company-strategy agents cover internal). Spine = 00-scope-and-research-plan.md + Phase 1 briefs A-E. Decision frame: open broad scan, layered 12-18mo + 3-5yr horizon, EU-primary / US-signal. HIGH workstreams: (A) EU regulation/certification/AI-error incidents, (B) EU reimbursement of health apps with examples+why+amounts, (C) competitive landscape (Sword Health, ambient-scribe-to-consumer move, direct patient-summary competitors). MEDIUM: (D) US demand-side macro, (E) incumbent platforms quick look. Deferred by Merlijn: capital/M&A (just raised), tech/product trends (wearables/UX/agentic), defensibility (his strategic conclusion). Engines: deep-research + market-research skill + foresight methods. Skills added this session: elements-of-style, market-research. Phase 1 COMPLETE (5 sourced briefs A-E); v1 synthesis written (01-market-trend-map-v1.md) with foresight layer (S-curve timing, 2x2 scenario, trend->threat/opp ledger). Headline: the patient summary is commoditizing from 3 directions (Epic Emmie live in NL hospitals; scribes/DAX into NL/BE early 2026; Kin Health funded US clone) so the moat is the patient-owned consent-first care relationship, not the summary; demand validated; Phase 2 COMPLETE (3 deep dives: A classification x reimbursement, B home-turf encroachment native-language sweep, C relationship/family moat). v2 synthesis written (02-market-trend-map-v2.md, supersedes v1) with 3 corrections: (1) DiGA does NOT require Class IIa - 95% of DiGA are Class I, so reimbursement is decoupled from the AI-Act-high-risk cliff, real wall is a clinical RCT; (2) Epic patient-direct threat is 2026-27 not today (Brief E overstated); (3) Mika is cautionary - no live permanent oncology-companion DiGA exists. Net thesis: summary commoditizes via portals ~2027-28, so build the patient+family relationship/network moat before then (recorded visit = wedge); reimbursement is a parallel optional track (new Dutch diga.nl scheme + B2B tariffs near-term, RCT-gated DiGA a 2-3yr/EUR1.5-3.5M bet). Tandem = Tandem Health (EU scribe, bought Juvoly). Open items: validate Dutch B2B pricing, re-verify incident stats. Deliverable ready for Merlijn's synthesis with product + company-strategy agent outputs.

artifacts.title: Brief D — US Demand-Side Macro Trends
artifacts.summary: Sourced, numbered brief covering 6 US demand vectors as leading signals for EU patient demand: (1) e-patient movement (65% portal access, 51% caregiver proxy doubling); (2) health literacy crisis ($236B cost, only 12% proficient, 40-80% of info forgotten immediately); (3) caregiver economy (63M US caregivers, $1T unpaid labor, 45% growth in a decade); (4) aging + chronic disease burden (76% of US adults with 1+ condition); (5) consumer health AI adoption (32% used AI chatbots in 2025 vs 16% in 2024, convenience beats accuracy); (6) after-visit summary demand (31-38% share AVS with family, 90%+ comprehension with plain-language). 24 numbered sources, EU read-across for each vector, confidence table, gaps for Phase 2.

artifacts.title: Phase-2 Dive B — The Encroachment Race (Native-Language EU Sweep)
artifacts.summary: Native-language (NL/DE/FR/BE) deep dive on who is taking Ditto's summary/recording artifact on home turf and how fast. Surfaced players English search missed: German B2C document-summarizers (Simply Onno 60k+ summaries/DIE WELT 2025 award, mein-arztbefund, Befino); the 'Doctolib-type' encroacher (Doctolib Consultation Assistant sends patient a digital summary, 6M+ consults; Doctolib Parents AI patient assistant early 2026); EHR-side patient letter-summaries shipping on home turf (ChipSoft HiX 'Patiëntvriendelijke brief' pilot w/ UZ Brussel+AZ Maria Middelares via COZO; ZAS Antwerp LIVE 2026-04-16, ~40k letters/yr); the one true NL+BE recording-to-patient-summary analog Clareco CoPilot (pre-traction). Key corrections: DAX/Dragon Copilot GA in NL+BE confirmed 2026-02-12 but clinician-only; Epic NL is clinician-mediated drafts not patient-direct, Ask Emmie unveiled HIMSS ~Mar 2026 with NO confirmed EU deployment (Brief E overstated). Nordics = clinician scribes only (Leapscribe; Tandem acquired NL's Juvoly). Open gap: patient-initiated + cross-provider + recording-based + multilingual + oncology-deep is still unoccupied in EU; threat is portal-side commoditization (est. standard-of-care NL/BE ~2027-28), not a built clone. 33 sourced refs. Builds on briefs C+E.

artifacts.title: Brief G — AI Market Movements (consumer/patient health)
artifacts.summary: The deferred tech/product-trend pass: AI market movements hitting consumer/patient health, global trend with EU read-across. Key finding: all three labs entered consumer health in one Jan-2026 week, directly Sherlocking Ditto's summary job (ChatGPT Health 7 Jan: connect portal/Apple Health, ask own labs; Claude for Healthcare 11 Jan via HealthEx 50k+ systems + Apple/Android beta; Gemini Health Coach $9.99/mo summarizes records). 230M+ weekly / 40M daily health questions on ChatGPT. Voice going primary (OpenAI merged voice into main UI Nov 2025; patient comfort with AI listening 60% 2026 vs 21% 2024; Hippocratic AI 180M+ patient voice interactions). Agentic is dominant frame but clinically hype-ahead-of-reality (Claude computer-use Mar 2026; only 3% orgs have agents live; Gartner: 40%+ agentic projects cancelled by 2027). Accuracy is the wound: BMJ Open ~50% chatbot health answers problematic, 40% reference completeness. Generative/malleable UI now production-ready (Google A2UI, CHI 2025) implying value migrates from fixed app to trusted data graph + actions. Thin-wrapper risk real & VC-validated as death; defensible profile = vertical+regulated+proprietary-data+workflow = Ditto's care-circle/family network + EU/GDPR trust + oncology depth + low-risk agentic care-circle actions, NOT the summary artifact. 42 numbered sources, every claim URL-cited, fact/inference/recommendation tagged, confidence+gaps table. Companion to briefs A-E and phase-2 dives; the AI-developments slice prior research under-covered.

artifacts.title: Brief H — Where the Patient+Family Care Relationship Lives Today (de-facto incumbent venues)
artifacts.summary: Maps the real, current venues where patients+families discuss health, coordinate care, and seek clarification BEFORE Ditto - the de-facto incumbents for the relationship, mostly NOT purpose-built apps. Four fragmented venues, each owns one slice of the job, none owns the whole: (1) AI chat = clarification venue, 40M+ ask ChatGPT health Qs daily, 48% to clarify medical terms/instructions, 1-in-4 US adults (66M+) used AI for health late-2025 (West Health-Gallup), patients uploading MyChart labs to ChatGPT (NPR/KFF) - fastest-growing + most behaviorally aligned = biggest threat AND proof of demand, but ungrounded/solo/not-GDPR-safe; (2) WhatsApp = the dominant but invisible channel, ~89% NL penetration, the family thread already runs there, no structure/record/roles/comprehension = ride it as distribution rail not rival (gap: no clean prevalence survey of family care groups); (3) patient communities - Inspire 3M+, CaringBridge ~300k/day, Kanker.nl 41k members/780k visits/mo, Carenzorgt/Caren (NL family-coordination, closest analog), Smart Patients, PatientsLikeMe (sold to UnitedHealth 2019 cautionary), Belong - own peer-support OR logistics, not visit-comprehension; (4) Facebook/Reddit groups - FB 70M+ in 6M+ health groups (2017, stale) but Gen Z decline 87->77%, Reddit 700+ health communities growing. Synthesis: classic consolidation gap - no one owns 'comprehend+coordinate THIS patient privately'; demand proven at massive scale so Ditto organizes existing behavior, not new behavior. Posture: out-specialize chatbots (lean on 35% trust + GDPR), ride WhatsApp, partner NL incumbents (Kanker.nl, Carenzorgt). 14 numbered source-groups, every claim URL-cited, fact/inference/estimate tagged, confidence+gaps table. Cross-refs phase2-C (competitors) + brief-E (incumbent platforms). Rich enough for 4-5 slides.

workflows.name: Refresh Product Context

Verifies Linear/Granola/Slack are live, fans out one read-only general-purpose agent per source, triangulates findings across >=2 sources, flags conflicts and internal-vs-team vocabulary, then updates the foundation doc + registry (with JSON validation) + memory. Delegates the live metrics to wf-006 (Update Product Analytics). Surfaces contradictions in point-in-time artifacts rather than rewriting them. Built 2026-05-30 from the first full refresh.
